package.description: Free game optimizer for Windows 10 and 11.

en-US.description: Free game optimizer for Windows 10 and 11.
en-US.longDescription: LeanFPS is a free game optimizer for Windows 10 and 11. It detects your game, applies per-genre tweaks, measures FPS and 1% lows, and undoes every change.
en-US.name: LeanFPS
